description: What changed in customizing, and why. Produced by config-doc; checked (with transport-record) by the realize→deploy Q-gate.

config_change.description: Transaction/IMG node, object, and the actual setting changed.

rationale.description: Why — should cite an upstream fit-to-standard decision-log Row ID or design-record. A config change with no upstream decision to point at is itself a finding.

guideline_check.description: Whether this conforms to knowledge/standards/config-guidelines.md; if not, the deviation must be stated, not silently passed.

transport_reference.description: Reference to the transport-record carrying this change — not duplicated, referenced.
